seven_slot_comparison_common.1_objects_spaces: Source has V subset R^d and real losses on legal predictions; packet generic definitions use an arbitrary carrier X and loss on all X. The squared-loss targets specialize to real observations and comparators [0,1]. Generic-carrier/feasibility generalization is explicit, not a literal whole-carrier transcription of the source game.
seven_slot_comparison_common.2_quantifiers: Source comparator is one fixed u across a horizon. Both packet predicates quantify separately over each u; no common threshold or common limit is imposed. Horizons use range T (0 through T-1), corresponding to source rounds 1 through T by reindexing.
seven_slot_comparison_common.3_assumptions: Only the first target takes an external logical hypothesis, hy: every observation is in [0,1]. Other target premises are empty and range must be proved for the concrete dyadic sequence. No hidden project-owned assumption bundles remain after expanding the seven supplied definitions.
seven_slot_comparison_common.4_conclusion_metric: Printed no-regret formula uses ordinary lim <= 0. NoRegret uses eventual epsilon upper bounds and does not require a limit. LimitNoRegret requires a finite nonpositive ordinary real limit per comparator. Best-in-hindsight regret and regret against fixed comparator 0 are distinct sequences.
seven_slot_comparison_common.5_constants_asymptotics: The printed result is the finite upper bound 4+4 ln T for T>=1 with initial guess 0.5. It alone supplies no lower bound or existence of a normalized regret limit. Candidate subsequence constants 2/3 and 1/3 and their precise horizon offsets are new claims, absent from the source.
seven_slot_comparison_common.6_probability_feedback: The relevant source route is deterministic and pathwise, allowing an adversary to observe the current prediction before choosing an observation. meanPredict uses only past observations. No IID, expectation, filtration, measurability or probability event is added by the packet. The preceding expected-loss motivation remains separate.
seven_slot_comparison_common.7_boundaries: Packet real division at zero gives empiricalMean 0=0 and normalized regret 0=0; these are totalization extensions of a positive-horizon source convention. Endpoints 0 and 1 are included. No minimax optimality or all-exercise completion is certified.
